mission: VAN Unified Personal Intelligence + Cognitive Symbiosis (Rev 1 / Rev 1.1)

wip_audit.method: git rev-list --count origin/main..<branch> for every remote branch
wip_audit.finding: Every gpt/* implementation branch is an ancestor of main. No unique required implementation is stranded on any branch, so §52's post-merge certification already holds for them.

workstreams.name: Mission Core (MissionService, state machine)
workstreams.note: Mission Core on migration 10: missions/mission_activities/mission_events, deterministic state machine, VERIFIED_SUCCESS unreachable without a verifier receipt. Activities bind to the capability registry.

workstreams.name: Success contracts and verification
workstreams.note: SuccessContract + VerificationRecord are mission-scoped and enforced; per-capability verifier adapters (§6) remain.

workstreams.name: Capability Registry (canonical)
workstreams.note: Canonical registry on migration 11 + registries/capabilities.json. Resolved the two-registry problem by splitting declaration from readiness: this registry declares, `readiness_source` delegates to the automation fabric / Google mesh / ExternalRuntimeRegistry that already owned that fact. No third copy of state.

workstreams.name: Capability Router / cognitive compression
workstreams.note: CapabilityRouter with policy as a hard pre-filter and pure arithmetic over declared facts. Route decisions persisted as evidence. Naming collision resolved: automation's router renamed AutomationMediumRouter (it selects the execution medium, not the capability).

workstreams.name: Context Compiler / ContextPacket
workstreams.note: context/ has service.py + retrieval.py (Rev 3.1 ContextSnapshot, deterministic lexical + graph retrieval). ContextPacket, token budget and cross-project isolation are absent.

workstreams.name: Memory taxonomy (10 stores)
workstreams.note: owner_facts, owner_context_edges, project_truth_cache, research_evidence and VEKL exist. Owner Cognitive Model, Strategic, Procedural, Anti-pattern, Shared Vocabulary, Intent Continuity are absent.

workstreams.name: Owner Cognitive Model
workstreams.note: No table, no service, no Android surface.

workstreams.name: Decision fingerprints
workstreams.note: decisions table records the decision, not the reasoning around it.

workstreams.name: Critical Reasoning Kernel
workstreams.note: No solver/critic/verifier separation anywhere.

workstreams.name: Fact/inference/preference separation
workstreams.note: EpistemicState + SourceTrust already enforce MODEL_DERIVED/INFERRED on Hermes writes (runtime_api.py). The 9-class semantic vocabulary is a superset of what exists.

workstreams.name: Adversarial self-review / anti-sycophancy
workstreams.note: Metrics in §17 (unsupported_agreement_rate <1%) need a labelled benchmark set that does not exist. Unmeasurable until ground truth is authored.

workstreams.name: External reality model
workstreams.note: research/ (Exa) supplies external evidence but there is no persistent world model.

workstreams.name: AI Evolution Radar
workstreams.note: trading/architecture/stack_lock.json governs adoption today; the radar must feed it, not bypass it.

workstreams.name: Strategy learning
workstreams.note: automation/telemetry.py (this branch) measures the HOT/WARM/COLD ladder and is the natural substrate for ExecutionStrategyRecord.

workstreams.name: Attention Engine 2.0
workstreams.note: attention/engine.py + attention table exist with upsert/dedupe/quiet-hours/snooze. Scoring fields (novelty, interruption_cost, actionability) are the delta.

workstreams.name: Proactive missions + S0-S5 autonomy
workstreams.note: Depends on WS1. Standing automation authority (command/standing.py) is the closest existing analogue and already forbids A4 as standing.

workstreams.name: Domain trust calibration
workstreams.note: automation/workflow_health.py (this branch) already models per-version trust decay and penalises false success; DomainTrust is the same shape one level up.

workstreams.name: Voice 2.0
workstreams.note: Wake pipeline, 'hie van' pre-rendered ack, PersonalSpeechModel, second-pass ASR fusion and signed transcript provenance all exist. Mission binding is the delta.

workstreams.name: Unified Android experience (6 surfaces)
workstreams.note: PR #37 already delivered summary-first drill-down. Home/Van/Missions/Needs You/Activity/Understanding as canonical top-level surfaces is the delta.

workstreams.name: Unified activity and evidence
workstreams.note: MissionEvent normalized; browser tasks and automation runs bind to Activities by reference via executor_ref. Backfill is idempotent and reversible. /v1/activity groups by mission; /v1/missions/{id}/evidence gathers receipts.

workstreams.name: Unified decisions
workstreams.note: DecisionService was already the single approval path; /v1/needs-you now presents waiting missions and open decisions as one surface.

workstreams.name: Privacy / permission registry
workstreams.note: capability_grants + google_connections exist; no owner-readable unified registry with origin/expiry/last-use/revoke.

workstreams.name: Durable orchestration (Temporal)
workstreams.note: Temporal is stack-locked at adoption phase 11 and NOT deployed. automation/router.py already routes critical_durable to TEMPORAL with an honest 'not yet built' detail.

workstreams.name: Computer Interaction Fabric
workstreams.note: Browser Fabric exists with typed ops and the exact 4 boundary-escalation states §38 specifies; owner-approved deltas already create separate durable authorizations (browser_scope_authorizations). Generalising beyond the browser is the delta.

workstreams.name: Development missions
workstreams.note: Project Truth protocol + CI + acceptance ledgers exist; not modelled as Missions.

workstreams.name: VanEval
workstreams.note: Several §41 targets are unmeasurable without an authored ground-truth set.

resolved_findings: Two capability registries: resolved by declaration/readiness split rather than merge.
CapabilityRouter name collision: automation's is now AutomationMediumRouter.
knowledge/vekl.py's /v1/missions/{mission_id}/vekl contract now has a Mission entity behind it.
